content: {"action":"plan","payload_json":"[{\"requirement_id\":\"req-revenue-query\",\"description\":\"Microsoft consolidated total revenue for FY2025 (year ended 2025-06-30) and FY2024 (year ended 2024-06-30), with units, periods and accounting basis.\",\"kind\":\"query\",\"query\":{\"records\":[{\"entity_id\":\"sec-0000789019\",\"metric_id\":\"revenue\",\"period\":{\"kind\":\"year\",\"start\":\"2024-07-01\",\"end\":\"2025-06-30\",\"basis\":\"source\"},\"value_kind\":\"actual\"},{\"entity_id\":\"sec-0000789019\",\"metric_id\":\"revenue\",\"period\":{\"kind\":\"year\",\"start\":\"2023-07-01\",\"end\":\"2024-06-30\",\"basis\":\"source\"},\"value_kind\":\"actual\"}]}},{\"requirement_id\":\"req-revenue-source\",\"description\":\"Original income statement blocks in the Microsoft FY2025 10-K (Item 8 heading, INCOME STATEMENTS heading, unit line, year headings and Total revenue row) showing FY2025 and FY2024 total revenue, plus any block that states the consolidated or US GAAP basis.\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"msft-2025-10k\"}]","reason":"Plan numeric query and original source evidence requirements; the earlier rejection came from putting source_id on a query requirement, so it is omitted here and kept only on the source_evidence requirement.","requirement_ids":[]}
